benchmark.negative_controls: 11 cited source-law families held out from pre-1900 encoder training

interpretation.estimand: discrimination and alert rate for later formula shapes relative to a frozen pre-1900 representation/four-form extrapolation task
interpretation.not_estimand: real-measurement discovery rate, historical publication-year classification, or rejection of all pre-1900 physics
interpretation.expected_hard_cases: Post-1900 laws exactly expressible as affine, power or exponential curves can correctly remain unflagged by a shape-only system.
interpretation.multiple_testing: Per-family learned conformal p-values are descriptive; with 40 calibration families their minimum is 1/41, so they cannot support a 55-test BH claim.
interpretation.framework_combination: OR and AND rows are transparent component combinations at their existing q95 thresholds; no new ensemble weight or threshold was fitted.
